Name in Other Languages

Korean

밤의 포옹자
(bam-ui poongja)

“ The stars have come to their rightful owner. „

Embracer of the Night (Korean: 밤의 포옹자, bam-ui poongja) is Crowberry Cookie's second Costume, released in the first half of the Holiday Training Academy Exam update. It is a Super Epic Costume that was only obtainable through exchanging 1,500 Grand Champions League Tokens during the GCL Limited Costume Shop! event during the associated GCL period.

Story

Crowberry Cookie, who carefully chose the most radiant stars from the Celestial Temple, cradles in her wings. Spreading her beautiful dark wings as she soars across the battlefield, a legend speaks of the victory, weaving an everlasting path of stars above.

Trivia

  • Embracer of the Night was accidentally added to the Costume Shop Gallery at the start of the Holiday Training Academy Exam update instead of the day beginning the Grand Champions League. It was swiftly removed in a hotfix.
  • Embracer of the Night was released alongside  Cradle of the stars.
  • As of the Falling Constellation Rescue update, the line "Temple of the Sky" in Embracer of the Night's description was changed to "Celestial Temple".

"Bird of Fire"

“ If you want to know more, you would have to pay the price. „

Feathered Flamestealer (Korean: 불을 머금은 새, bureul mogeumeun sae, "Bird of Fire") is Crowberry Cookie's first Costume, released in the first half of The Treasure of Legends update. It is an Epic Costume that can be obtained either by drawing it from the Costume Gacha or by purchasing it in the Rainbow Crystal Shop.

Story

According to ancient legends, there was a tall tower beyond the mountains, where a fiery bird resided. The bird, said to have come from the Dragon's Valley, lived in silence, until suddenly releasing a cry accompanied by violet flames... What could it be trying to warn the Cookies about?

Trivia

  • Feathered Flamestealer was released alongside  Immortal Cataclysm.
